programme.title: Putin's Patriots
programme.desc: As Russia faces growing international isolation, loyalists within the 30 million-strong Russian diaspora are dedicated to defending, supporting and promoting Putin overseas Vladimir Putin has made it clear that he wants Russia to reclaim its former glory: across the globe, Russians echo his sentiment, shutting down critics of the Kremlin From jeering newspaper articles, to counter-protestors staring down protestors who condemn the jailing of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny, Putin's international supporters are a force to be reckoned with

programme.title: Sins of My Father
programme.desc: A father, a criminal A son seeking peace Two victims' sons One story of revenge and reconciliation, told by their children

programme.title: Ganz: How I Lost My Beetle
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Beetle is a design classic Celebrated by the Nazis, and championed by Hitler, the Beetle's true origins were obscured by a web of intrigue, espionage and slander This extraordinary doc reveals the untold story of Josef Ganz, the Jewish visionary behind one of the world's most adored cars As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history

A team of reporters and producers fanned out across the country to track down the people who found themselves in the centre of the firestorms What emerges are incredible stories of survival, bravery and heartbreak

programme.title: Addicted to Sheep
programme.desc: In the uplands of North East England, Tom and Kay Hutchinson set out on a near impossible task: to breed the perfect Swaledale Sheep They toil through sun, hail, sleet and snow to rear their flock Life on the fells is by turns idyllic and tough Surrounded by an ever-changing and stunning landscape, the family battle against the weather, financial challenges and the bizarre propensity of sheep to suddenly drop dead

programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? programme.title: 專題講座:慕約翰牧師特會 - 同行轉化

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福音電影: 亞洲英雄-沒有硝煙的戰爭
programme.desc: 自古亂世出英雄,在2003年春天的一場沒有硝煙的戰爭中,一群捨己救人的真英雄誕生了。在一輪出生入死的拚搏過後,寫下了香港杏林史上引以為傲的一頁,亦叫早己冷卻的心再一次跳動。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 榮主的職場
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《榮主的職場》。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 讚美之泉
programme.desc: 一首既悅耳又有意思的詩歌,可以洗滌心靈,感化人心,創世電視帶你走進福音歌曲新領域。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-見字如面 從傳教士翻譯聖經 看福音的價值
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

高朋滿座#192粵
programme.desc: Sugar相約溢尋找「反翻版超級絕密秘笈」，溢發現Sugar對秘笈全不熱衷，她終承認全屬虛構，目的是要溢陪她找「傳說中的夾餅」。Sugar指溢他吃飯時只顧看雜誌而不理食物質素，等同在吃「頹廢飯」。

programme.title: 玉樓春#6粵普PG
programme.desc: 大哥、玉樓金榜題名，獲封官位。賈逢源投身孫遜門下，搬入孫府。少春本欲告訴玉樓為父申冤一事，被嬤嬤打斷。少春為試探玉樓是否公正廉明，引導聲稱兒子被孫府仗勢打死的王婆向玉樓告狀。滴珠扮成師爺助玉樓斷案。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
今個夏天食平D粵
programme.desc: 購入廉宜金菇，以超抵價錢做出「金菇煙肉卷」；想除去「南乳炸雞翼」的雪味，肥媽有何妙法？簡單幾下手勢，將多項食材切絲，便可蒸出美味三刀魚！煎香紅衫魚煲成魚湯，加入絲瓜、魚腐一起煮，一次過做出兩款小菜！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 長期壓力過大、患糖尿病等，都可能誘發自律神經失調，症狀包括心悸、消化不良等，可嚴重影響日常生活。精神科醫生細說治標、治本的藥物治療，並建議患者透過靜觀、認知行為治療等方法改善病情，同時帶來預防貼士。前記者早年留意到歐美的銀髮模特兒風氣後，將這概念引入香港，創辦相關公司，她會分享創業點滴。同來的銀髮模特兒細談入行契機與深刻拍廣告經歷，難忘曾和樂壇巨星合演母子。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨奉上「冬蔭酸菜魚」。

programme.title: 懿想得到粵
programme.desc: 麥美恩予人大癲大肺的形象，這次她要學做淑女，還享受被諾懿照顧的感覺！二人先到馬來西亞怡保大玩驚險的激流，美恩初見教練竟馬上求愛！享用過大排檔的冷糕、布拉腸粉等美食後，二人再向飛餅大師學藝。品嚐正宗印度菜需要徒手用餐，美恩能否保持斯文面貌？美恩及後換上馬拉傳統服飾，與諾懿前往度假村的洞穴餐廳。在浪漫氣氛下，美恩大談感情觀，卻又為何感觸落淚？她更揚言要為將來的男友學煮「怡保豆腐火腩飯」，挑戰結果如何？

programme.title: 天梯#22粵PG
programme.desc: 愛娣失蹤，美娟只得向賓客宣布送了她往醫院。坤堯當眾說出愛娣不是美娟契女，而是世章情婦。世豪指美娟有計畫謀奪財產，美娟手持賀家歷代的神主牌出來。愛娣在火車站再次遇到陳成，更被搶去錢包，鄭嬌發狂般打陳成。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子欣賞春天的花，花輪送不同顏色的鬱金香給她、小玉和小渚，小渚為花語問題弄得情緒激動。小丸子、小玉和花輪在公園結識性格酷似花輪的花真，兩人迅速成為好友，為掛念父母的花輪帶來慰藉。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這回「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，除了手腳要做好熱身，連耳朵也要準備好！第一節「反應與速度訓練」，需聽從指令做動作。地面放有不同顏色的豆袋，用手或腳觸碰指定目標，小心犯錯！教練還要求大家排成一直線，展開反應跑特訓。第二輪的「伸展與放鬆訓練」則需要瑜伽墊、橡筋帶及網球，坐好後以雙手舉高橡筋帶，同時向側彎腰，姿勢要正確；橡筋帶繞過雙腳，盡量拉向身體。站穩，用腳底移動地下的網球，藉按壓放鬆筋膜。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 公主們想說服莉莉收手，然而莉莉在悲傷中難以自拔，更不惜消耗自己的音樂之力，以凌厲之勢向公主揮劍。就在公主危急關頭，阿堇及時現身阻止莉莉，更以姐姐身分表白心跡，融化莉莉的冰結內心。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
programme.desc: 現代社會離婚率有上升趨勢，夫婦婚姻破裂，最受影響的是年幼下一代。離婚之後，獨力支撐家庭，單親路亦困難重重。新聞掏寶和大家重溫1990年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
宏利保險呈獻：灣區零距離粵
滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 屯門某私人物業進行外牆維修期間，業戶曾投訴工人未有佩戴安全帶，及後發現單位外牆圍欄遭割花，懷疑被人報復。事主於按摩院體驗「盆骨收窄小臀術」，一次療程後出現半身麻痺狀況，經急症室診斷為左腦中風。攝製隊隨同事主到按摩院追究，店方卻拒絕提供相關療程紀錄，並報警驅趕，其後更刪除小臀術的帖文？范子睿舉行粉絲見面會，獲《中年好聲音4》戰友現身支持，更撐他是「中聲友誼先生」！另介紹秋季家居博覽的內容與優惠情報。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#34粵
programme.desc: 安多勳對萬里與楊帆曾成為舞伴一事耿耿於懷，認定楊帆有意追求萬里，遂以他與萬里的合照宣示主權，楊帆卻不以為意，其一番話更令安多勳覺得對方有意爭奪萬里。安多勳其後多番向楊帆挑戰，欲證明自己更勝一籌，卻屢屢碰壁。楊帆察覺安多勳有異，遂刻意避開他。另一方面，安多勳託嘉驄繪畫他與萬里的卡通畫，更揚言要向全世界宣告萬里是他的女人。嘉驄懷疑他打算求婚，卻得悉萬里無意結婚，遂將此事告知她。萬里急忙找安多勳解釋……

programme.title: 死有對証#14粵PG
programme.desc: 城中發生幾宗少女自殺案，死者都在遺書留下「我要成為葬禮的天使」，淑嫻等人着手調查。碧芝認定雪蕾向老師舉報她吸食電子煙，聯群結黨欺凌雪蕾，雪蕾憤然掌摑碧芝，被訓導主任要求見家長。淑嫻不但沒有諒解雪蕾，反而與她起衝突，雪蕾氣結跑走。高俊替志傑抱不平，揶揄佩嘉將志傑當作觀音兵；芷昕不忿，情急之下說出遇見美寧與一男子舉止親暱之事。高俊發現雪蕾也曾登入「葬天使」自殺網，與淑嫻趕往學校，一名女學生突然墮樓……

programme.title: 百花殺#16粵普
programme.desc: 汐和感激華雍大婚夜安排她見父兄，太后有意為華雍納側妃，汐和故作大度；青姝在太后宴會上施計表現與瀠繞姐妹情深，汝陽郡主邀汐和一敘，借煮茶暗示與華雍有舊情；瀠繞失貞無法嫁給寧王，青姝遊說瀠繞服假死藥私奔。

programme.title: 藍朋友‧旅朋友 福州篇粵
programme.desc: 上回嚐過矜貴的佛跳牆，祖藍這集帶靜文轉試平民價版本，還加碼點滿燜豬手、清蒸閩江白刀魚、鹽酒花螺雞等豐盛菜式，人均消費卻不需一百元。平潭島上有不少台式美食，而且很多店舖都由台灣人經營。除了可找到大腸包小腸、蚵仔煎、鹽酥雞、燒仙草等地道小吃，再走進餐廳嚐一口滷肉飯，讓人仿如瞬間置身寶島。相約一位移居平潭的台灣人，獲對方以台式家常菜招待，端上椒鹽花枝丸、麻油腰花、三杯雞等經典台菜，主持們口腹大滿足。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#14粵
programme.desc: 各人知道文初曾發出聲音，欲令文初再開聲，惜徒勞無功。海琳自沛堅與曼玲蜜月回來後答允男同學們的約會，君好氣結。冰心送手錶給展輝做生日禮物，二人和好。君好盲腸炎送院，展輝趕往澳門探望，卻遺下銀包沒證件回港。冰心等不到展輝回來慶祝生日而憤怒。禮信向冰心編說與展輝被困在升降機中，冰心原諒展輝。莎嬌與君好將展輝留下之手錶送回，竟遇冰心及冰芬，四人推撞間令君好再受傷。來順見海景咳出血大驚，海景淡然說出患肺癌。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: 懿想得到粵
programme.desc: 來到馬來西亞，怎能錯過當造榴槤？諾懿、麥美恩同赴吉隆坡，一嚐特產「貓山王」！諾懿還會炮製榴槤西多士，滋味如何？美恩接受終極挑戰，為三位風格各異的男士製作咖喱雞飯；猛男們則用才藝表演作回敬，誰能打動美恩芳心？與美恩分別後，諾懿深入檳城叢林，享受獨處時光。置身特色帳篷房間露台，細聽蟬鳴鳥語，份外寫意自在！諾懿又到訪附近香草園，採摘新鮮斑蘭葉煮海鮮湯。他還參觀當地一個1600呎的家，何以大表羨慕？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#35粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰提議一家人共度傳統中秋節，一起紥燈籠、吃團圓飯兼賞月；萬里卻堅持到酒店吃自助餐，母女因此鬧得不歡而散。原來嘉冰執意親手製作燈籠，背後另有原因。萬里本已軟化打算讓步遷就嘉冰，豈料意外揭破她的謊言，遂決意與她對着幹，令嘉驄、唐芯左右為難。嘉冰後來向嘉驄道出她回港的真正原因，以及一段不為人知的遇險經歷，惟萬里認定那只是她博取同情的謊言。中秋節當天，嘉冰準備好一切，卻始終等不到萬里等家人回來……

programme.title: 死有對証#15粵PG
programme.desc: 碧芝墮樓身亡，淑嫻走上天台調查，竟見披頭散髮的雪蕾。原來雪蕾約了碧芝見面，二人更發生爭執……雪蕾成墮樓案嫌疑人，淑嫻小隊和林琛分別要避嫌而不能參與調查。高俊到學校探聽消息被拒，卻意外撞見裝扮成學生的記者；高俊要求和柏宇、佩嘉合作，共享資訊。芷昕解剖後，確認碧芝死於墮樓，卻發現她的口腔和手上有異樣……高俊遇見一男子開着名車接載美寧。

programme.title: 百花殺#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 華雍邀汐和遊春，二人感情升溫。瀠繞被刺死，青姝如願嫁入寧王府，汐和命人徹查此事。榮妃借御香熄滅陷害汐和，汐和從香灰驗出異常金粉，並追查至侍女玉婉，榮妃被奪權。汐和執掌宮務，整頓女官，立升遷憑才幹之規。

programme.title: 藍朋友‧旅朋友 福州篇粵
programme.desc: 繼續探索平潭島上的台灣風情，一桌台式私房菜帶給祖藍、靜文不少驚喜。苦瓜鳳梨雞湯味道甜中帶苦；賣相似腰花，口感像雞腎的香芹炒烏魚珍，都是二人從未嚐過的滋味配搭！深入「南島語」主題博物館，認識這種使用人口達4億的語系。台灣阿美族亦是其中之一，兩主持還學唱民謠。入夜後往海邊觀賞藍眼淚，祖藍、靜文感受大自然奇景。海風輕吹下，他們高歌告別平潭。回到南寧，祖藍、倬昕換上正裝，帶觀眾參觀第23屆中國東盟博覽會。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#15粵
programme.desc: 文初與禮信無意中聽到海琳替君好分析二人在君好心目中的地位，文初難過地離開。展輝安排莎嬌入住酒店方便照顧君好，冰心妒火中燒。冰心與展輝收到健康被綁架傳真，冰心一口咬定是莎嬌所為。原來大志因廠房倒閉，又遭妻離棄，雙重打擊下綁架健康。禮信與文初循健康哭聲找到他，莎嬌情急智生想出妙法救回健康，但禮信與文初卻被大志推落樓，君好即時撲向文初，禮信難受。來順忍不住說出海景患肺癌，莎嬌向海景提出結婚，卻遭他拒絕。

programme.title: 巴打秘景遊粵
programme.desc: 置身遠離繁囂的荔枝窩，「巴打」在生態導師帶領下夜探郊野，上一堂大自然生態課。預定到海岸邊賞日出，陳浚霆卻「唔知醒」，拍檔們決定大整蠱！歎杯金針花茶後，三人初試下田施肥與耘田，有人「泥足深陷」，焦浩軒更把工具弄斷？他們還獲居民設宴招待，品嚐家常客家菜。鴨洲可以找到罕見的褐紅色沉積岩，「鴨頸」、「鴨眼」更是必到打卡點！緊接到訪鄰近小島吉澳，巴打入鄉隨俗，體驗釣魚之餘，也會學做客家茶粿，感受純樸人情味。

programme.title: 香港原味道粵
programme.desc: 中秋將至，深水埗老字號餅家特別推出「金腿五仁月餅」。庭鋒、正峰幫忙切材料，為何搓餅皮時需加入舊餅皮？裹入餡料再倒模好講手勢，正峰卻將月餅拍落地，德丞則手指中招，還是交給師傅！新鮮水果中秋糕餅健康不膩，阿譚與德賢親手起果肉、打汁、煮漿整西柚糕、百香果糕；不妨試試「紫薯忌廉月餅」，真材實料，口感層次無得頂。9月13日是「國際花生日」，食品廠的傳統花生糖，新派「蜂辣花生」、「麻辣腰果」啱晒「花生友」。

programme.title: 香港原味道粵
programme.desc: 素食餐廳的自家製新派素Pizza、漢堡、炸雞等，似模似樣！庭鋒親手搓芋圓，真材實料，芋頭味香濃。負責人為家人積極推廣素食，得到父親撐到底，經過無數挑戰、失敗，研製出似到十足的炸雞，當中有何奧妙？素菜館推出應節純素奶黃流心月餅，阿譚與幸美一起製作，看當中的雞蛋有何替代品，而流心餡又如何製作？中秋節點少得楊桃，見有機農場的楊桃正慢慢成長，庭鋒與德賢轉移目標到大大梳的大蕉、牛奶蕉，卻怎麼變成鋸蕉樹？

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 北宋楊家將三代從軍，穆桂英在陣前產子。楊延昭母佘太君得皇上御賜龍頭拐杖，更曾帶十二寡婦征西？當中涉及多個「歷史大誤解」！「古代新聞」大爆隋、唐宮廷秘聞；羅拔與陳仔為流氓推薦捕快「筍工」！

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 西楚霸王項羽在戰場上所向披靡，其中一個原因可能與虞姬形影不離有關。可惜這對中國版亂世佳人，最終亦悲劇收場。四面楚歌，霸王別姬！本集「史上最強」來看看史上一段可歌可泣的愛情故事。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 加蓬是對比強烈之地：棕櫚海灘、遼闊紅樹林、原始森林與開闊大草原塑造當地人生活。從市場、漁村與森林儀式到稻田、聖地及有大猩猩、大象和海洋生物的國家公園，這國家正努力守護傳統、野生生物與脆弱的自然遺產。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 蒙古有世界上最勇悍的人，弓在不同年代的蒙古都有著一不同的作用和意義。用大自然的材料製成的弓，通過工匠們的巧手和智慧，展現出它柔軟靈活的特性。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥德拉厄，這個船長小鎮，早年是鯡魚貿易中心，後海港沒落，繁華已逝，但老城區依然保留兩百年前的風貌。印度梅加拉亞邦是全國最不想生兒子的地方。女兒國凱西族婦女享有獨特社會地位，扮演著維繫家族血脈的角色。

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
programme.desc: 「十二門徒石」與「倫敦拱橋」是維多利亞州必到的著名景點，胡蓓蔚偕姚子羚乘坐直昇機遊覽兩個天然奇觀，動人美景竟不及型男機師吸引？超大型復古商店在港少見，胡蓓蔚、胡杏兒啟動「血拼」模式，懷舊時裝「著咗先講」！二人又請墨爾本最具影響力的女裝設計師選配衣飾，穿戴後驚艷全場！胡說八道會六位美女成員「睇得又煮得」，李施嬅、子羚深懂善用時間，實行一邊買菜一邊品酒。用餐時間，施嬅突然含淚吐真言，所為何事？

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵PG
programme.desc: Ben、柏豪攜帶輕量級裝備前赴塔門露營，缺乏食材下，唯有出海捕捉海膽、海刺，幸好有水上人提供法寶，收穫無難度！用海膽炒個靚飯，Ben提起拍《鐵探》時的挨餓狀況，得出結論是「飢餓令人清醒」？兩個大男孩見有人放紙鳶，興起亦要玩一番！手上只有魚絲及背心膠袋，「發明家」柏豪領軍重拾「懷舊風箏」情趣……入夜後，二人炮製天婦羅與綠豆沙醫肚，笑談兒時的頑皮經歷，以及入行前的工作經驗，原來Ben曾擔任全裸模特兒？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主凱文滿心雀躍向凱婷、汛文分享榴槤資訊，怎料兩拍檔卻並非榴槤愛好者，也印證大眾對這種水果喜惡兩極。據悉全球有逾二百種榴槤，除了港人熟識的泰國金枕頭、馬來西亞貓山王，凱文透露自己更鍾情黑刺品種，大讚其美味程度超越貓山王！凱婷縱不好榴槤，卻自言有揀選心得？榴槤引發不少公共空間爭議，新加坡就有規定禁止在地鐵與公共巴士上攜帶未經真空包裝的榴槤。凱文開心列舉各式榴槤製食品，拍檔則提醒她有不少飲食禁忌。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 聲夢1+2粵
programme.desc: 藍隊侯雋熙、彭家賢、劉詠彤；紅隊何晉樂、金永衡、趙頌宜玩轉澳門，外援譚嘉儀、羅毓儀亦會於你唱我吹爆波遊戲正面交鋒！複製任暟晴倒播聲帶估歌仔，某隊展現神級聆聽、模仿力。對方完成攀爬挑戰前，猜出混播的十首歌，估歌的晉樂見家賢驚慌中不禁要打卡。搶Fo回合亂成一團，毓儀玩到瞓地，詠彤被抱起搬走！動漫歌曲爭霸戰，兩隊唱出多首粵語經典，再以熱爆日文歌對壘。聲夢基地，眾人比拼歌詞大搜索，還自揭「我有你冇」之事。

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: 兩位祥哥一邊預備月餅及賞月水果，一邊分享昔日的中秋佳節回憶；MEN’S TALK環節則提到男女大不同，女人永遠不懂男人的五件事，你們的另一半又是否一樣不懂你的心？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 《地球大神秘》在過去兩輯，為大家從世界各地大神秘事物之中尋找出路，從而應對未知的將來，並於即將播放的新一輯節目當中，藉揭開終極神秘Secret X更了解地球奧秘。所謂「前事不忘、後事之師」，我們在新一輯節目播放之前，先播放過往兩輯節目的精選片段，透過重溫部分重點大神秘，讓我們從中得到嶄新啟發，為即將進入更深入的尋秘之旅打下更堅實的基礎。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 眾人不敵炎上達，回到神七結界暫避。為了修復七彩方塊，必須找到瑪蘿另一個弟弟須佐之男，誰知他便是麥格，然而失去記憶。為了阻止炎上彈完成，繼八百萬神後，鳳凰、玄武和白虎亦出外迎戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 做心肺功能訓練，難免會喘氣，準備好就來「WORKOUT 2GETHER」！重複雙腳跳及單腳跳、重複開合跳和深蹲、原地間歇跑，這三組動作都是以30秒為一節，運動20秒再休息10秒，連環做才有效果。拉出一張瑜伽墊，就可轉做全身肌力訓練，先模仿熊的爬行動作，再做一節膝上壓及一節超人式。然後維持掌上壓的起始姿勢，試試雙手碰對側肩膀，甚或開合跳。兒童體適能教練提醒每組運動之間都有休息間隔，也要記得量力而為。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 湯馬士離世後，安妮面對離別與成長抉擇。瑪麗拉鼓勵她升讀大學，戴安娜亦踏入訂婚新階段，令安妮感到人生轉折逼近。經歷拉文妲的婚禮、與學生道別後，安妮終於決定秋天啟程前往雷德蒙大學，展開新篇章。

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 日本人字牌救心呈獻：修哥九五至尊無限楓騷演唱會粵
programme.desc: 修哥又再踏上紅館舞台開騷兼創紀錄，《聲秀》和《中聲3》唱將以<Monica歡迎坐着九五至尊龍椅登場的主角！修哥獨唱<情花開、<往事只能回味、<每一個晚上等金曲，還鬼馬演繹<禪院鐘聲，寶刀未老。而「派對」部份嘉賓近年較少跟香港歌迷見面，陳松伶、羅嘉良就從北京返港支持修哥。陳奕迅亦應修哥要求清唱<Shall We Talk，張學友特意揀選<不老的傳說送贈修哥，張家輝卻搞怪帶來<忘情水？

programme.title: 香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵
programme.desc: 舞者Bobby林悅榮將代表香港出戰街舞大賽，與各地頂尖選手較量，心情如何？小舞者丘岳早前勇奪國際街舞比賽青少年組別兩個冠軍，他細訴習舞緣由。電競女主播彭泳熙從電競運動員出身，近年更發展歌手事業，箇中有何點滴？東方女子足球隊成立，球隊上下盼五年內由丙組聯賽升上甲組；另搜羅港超足球比拼精華。方力申將挑戰從香港游至澳門，送上記招花絮。另帶來女子十五人欖球賽、田徑系列賽的戰報，以及亞殘運港隊授旗儀式花絮。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時(完)
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 舊金山美容院
programme.desc: 【劉品言×連晨翔青梅竹馬假戲真做，成為彼此最溫暖的避風港！！】圍繞經營美容院、早餐店及玩具工場的三個家庭展開故事，有人因身陷陷害而失業、有人不受重視，也有人想要利用他人鬥倒同父異母的兄姊，在每一段所展開的復仇之路中，發現兩代之間的糾葛，以及上一代的恩怨怎麼導致下一代的感情迫害。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 水龍吟
programme.desc: 【羅雲熙尋找弒師真相的亡命追途，改寫江湖的命運！！】十年前，唐儷辭親眼目睹師門覆滅，卻被誣陷成弒師兇手，從天之驕子淪為人人喊打的罪人背負沉冤，只為查清那場血案背後真正的黑手。多年後，他帶著刻入骨血的信念重返江湖。為尋找真相，潛入暗勢力盤踞的「十三樓」，捲入武林與朝野交織的陰謀；與此同時，他結識池雲、鍾春髻等真心相伴之人，也在危機四伏的旅途中重新學會信任與牽掛。

programme.title: 舊金山美容院

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire

David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house's owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: Hai Zhi Yao - EP3

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai…

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Fugitives
programme.desc: Now that they’re officially on the run, the team heads down to Mexico City to hide out in one of Ms. Nowhere’s many safe houses. With super-agent Palindrome and the police hot on their tales, they decide the only way they’re going to survive is by getting their hands on some money by winning an underground derby race.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Ocelot King vs. El Mariposa
programme.desc: Unable to decide how to prove their innocence, the team has a huge fight! Ms. Nowhere and Echo Pearl reach out to Palindrome with the evidence they've collected while Tony and Cisco find Uncle Tuco at a lucha libra match, where Cisco must face the ultimate question: can you always trust family?

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Goodbye Crood World
programme.desc: When Phil detects a meteor is hurtling towards the farm, the Bettermans and Croods must decide how to spend their last day on earth.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Sticky Business
programme.desc: Struggling to find their purpose on the Betterman farm, the Croods see an opportunity to prove their worth by harvesting Phil’s perilous (and sticky) bounceberries.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Guy Time
programme.desc: When Eep wants alone time with her new friend Dawn, Guy seeks a new friend of his own and finds an unlikely companion in Thunk.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Qilin-mania
programme.desc: Superstar-level mania sets in when the renowned and prosperity-brining creature Qilin appears in front of Yi’s building. In trying to protect Qilin from the mob of people hoping for their wishes to be granted, the crew is distraught when they lose track of the creature. Their distress grows upon discovering that this “Qilin” isn’t an auspicious mythical creature at all but a nefarious robot sent by a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Shack Attack
programme.desc: "The crew tracks down the source of the havoc-wreaking robot “Qilin” and winds up trapped by Mr. Lung, the Minticon-using candymaker who disappeared in Season 1. While captive, Yi and the crew learn of a higher power known as the Great Watchers, and that Mr. Lung is furious at Yi for unwittingly replacing him as the GW-approved keeper of magical creatures. Saddled with these mind-blowing revelations, the crew must find a way to escape and stop Mr. Lung from using creature magic for evil."

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Liam The Hero
programme.desc: In order to get a ticket to a Manga convention she desperately wants, Birch agrees to write a series of Manga strips featuring Liam as a suave, cool and heroic character. When Birch finally gets a chance to sit down and talk to her hero, he turns out to be a jerk.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - True Colors
programme.desc: When Raffi joins Amelia's rock band, Birch follows on his heels as the band's manager. Soon she's writing songs that pit her and Raffi against their podmates. Pod 4's true colors are revealed once Birch realizes she's gone too far.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Love Lessons
programme.desc: Liam's role as romance advisor to the boys of Cosmos High gets under Birch's skin. Offended that Liam thinks female behaviour is nothing more than a collection of symbols, Birch watches as Liam misinterprets Sandra's signals and ends up with pie on his face.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Miss President
programme.desc: Birch runs for school president because she wants to see changes to the Art program at Cosmos High. On a whim, Liam gets involved and soon his goofy antics are winning him favours. Before long, it's an all-out game of one-upmanship between the two cousins

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Fashion Show
programme.desc: After attending a disappointing fashion show with Grandma, Olivia designs some fabulous clothes and is determined to put on her own show. Unfortunately, her models (Ian, Francine and Julian) prove to be more difficult to work with than she'd anticipated. It's up to Olivia to think fast and make the fashion show work!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Makes A Video
programme.desc: When Father takes an out-of-town business trip, Olivia doesn't want him to miss a thing. She decides to create a video diary, filming her family and classmates' everyday life, which isn't quite as exciting as she'd hoped. So Olivia adds her own touch to the final presentation: a big song and dance finish. Dad is thrilled.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Leads A Parade
programme.desc: As Mother tries to get baby William to sleep, Olivia, Ian and Julian create a backyard parade. When Francine finds out, she decides she's going to make her OWN parade. Olivia eventually sees that two parades can be better than one –and even figures out how to keep fussy William asleep.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Tends To The Sick
programme.desc: Julian comes down with a case of “itchyfootitis,” so it's Dr. Olivia to the rescue, with all kinds of silly treatments. When the “condition” begins to spread to others, Olivia imagines herself running an entire “itchy foot” clinic, and eventually discovers the perfect cure.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Secret Ingredient Delete That Dew!
programme.desc: When Harper is missing an ingredient to make her Mom’s favorite dessert on Mother’s Day, Eden enlists the help of her fellow Dew Drops to do an emergency city-wide ingredient search! When Marcus records a video of his inventions, Phoebe gets caught on camera and must erase the footage before Marcus sees, or her Dew Drop cover will be blown!

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Rodney J. Dinkle, Babysitter Lights Out
programme.desc: When accident-prone Rodney gets hired to babysit a mischievous toddler, TZG secretly watches over their safety. When there’s a power outage in Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly helps the townsfolk beat the blackout.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Double Booked Gym Enemy Cricket
programme.desc: When both Sam and Gabriel pre-order the new Commander Kale comic but the supplier only sends one copy, TZG secretly ferries the comic book back and forth between readers. When Fawna teaches a silent yoga class, TZG secretly find and remove a loud chirping cricket from the Community Center.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Merry Scary Christmas Time Waits For No Ghost
programme.desc: Merry Scary Christmas It's Christmas and Casper wants to spend the holiday with his human pal, Jimmy. Time Waits for No Ghost When Casper discovers a clock that can stop time, everyone wants to use it for his or her own purpose.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Ghostbust A Move My Fair Harpy
programme.desc: Ghostbust a Move When Jimmy's dad decides to move the family away from Deedstown, Casper and his friends vow to stop Mr. Bradley from selling their house. My Fair Harpy The Winter Chill Dance is coming up and Ra is determined to be king.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harper’s first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harper’s Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they’ re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Full House Gift Express
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Eden’s fairy home. But it creates a BIG problem when Harper’s family wants to visit grandma and the car keys are nowhere to be found! When Harper gets sick, Marcus builds a pulley between their apartments to send Harper treats. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues
programme.desc: Chef J tells Ollie he cooks with love. Kelp and Ollie set out to make food with love for him. When various food combos fail, Ollie considers giving up, because it isn’t good enough. Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what he’s feeling.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize he’s missing home. Kelp feels like he can’t choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Catch Me If You Sam Toy Driver
programme.desc: It’s Tag and Scooch’s first day of Race Cadets and Sam Whippet tells the Cadets that whoever can catch him in a race will be the new team captain. \ When Mom donates a box of Tag’s old toys to the new daycare center, Tag decides that the only way to get her box of toys back is to go around town collecting toys to swap out for her toys.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Frank and Beans with Chili Little Hound on the Prairie
programme.desc: Beans is nervous that Frank is starting to make a new best friend, so Beans enlists Tag to help him win Frank back. \ Grandpaw and Grandmaw tell Tag the story of the early days of Pawston. Tag’s ancestor, Tagatha, built a steam-engine and turned Pawston from a one-house town into a thriving community.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Sick Day
programme.desc: When the other dragons come down with the flu, Summer must overcome her fear of eels to retrieve the cure and get her friends back in the air.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Bad Egg
programme.desc: Magnus hatches a plan to hide in an egg to spy on the Rescue Riders. But things get all scrambled when a mama dragon takes him to her nest.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - CupKate
programme.desc: It’s Kate’s birthday and everyone in the habitat has something amazing planned- but Melman’s worried that his homemadehoof-made gift won’t measure up. While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesn’t matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Pest Side Story
programme.desc: Gloria becomes determined to earn her Queen of Kindness Kidizen badge and welcomes some free-spirited rats who need a place to stay into the habitat. Despite her discomfort, Gloria encourages the rats to make themselves at home. When the rats play with her special baby tusk at the bottom of her tank, she finally snaps and sends the rats home. It isn't until the gang winds up at the rats' nest and Gloria almost takes a slice of the rats special cheese that she learns it's okay to say no.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - The Poppy Horror Picture Show Dinkles Dinkles Little Star
programme.desc: After hearing a scary story Poppy tries to help Biggie get over his fearsHoping to enhance Mr. Dinkles selfconfidence Biggie enters him into a Bergen pet show.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - The Party Games Trolly Tales
programme.desc: Everyone gets excited because its time for the Trolls Annual funbased Party GamesPoppy and Branch try to convince the Troll kids that the library is fun.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Doom and Groom
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayesh's wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Mister Mastodon
programme.desc: Po and team arrive in Guatemala and meet farmers who are facing a mysterious threat-- named The Protector, wielding the Storm Wheels. Elsewhere, Colin the Stag Knight and Weimin team up to go after Po and discover Mr. Ping's connection to the widely feared Pirate Queen.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Picture Perfect
programme.desc: Tim and Boss Baby want to bond with Dad by recreating a perfect "Dudes Weekend' camping trip, culminating in a photo opp, but everything seems to go wrong

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Play It Again, Tim
programme.desc: When Tim is forced to take piano lessons, he actually enjoys them and Boss Baby realizes that Tim is being brainwashed by his piano teacher, slowly turning Tim into an old man

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Research & Developments
programme.desc: Turtleneck wants to crack the Stinkless Serum formula and makes it a competition, pitting worker babies against worker babies, stating that the first one to the Serum will be the new CEO!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - That's a Moray
programme.desc: When the team learns of several robberies in Mexico City that resemble the attack on the agency. Ms. Nowhere puts the pieces together and realizes who set them up: an ex-operative she used to work with named Moray. Now, she and the crew must infiltrate a masquerade ball to come face to face with Moray and figure out what he's up to.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Siege
programme.desc: Moray attacks the hauler with an EMP sending it into emergency lockdown and trapping the team inside. Now, it’s up to Roscoe, the only one small enough to fit through a vent, to find help. Meanwhile, Palindrome hunts down Moray using the evidence gathered by Ms. Nowhere.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Into the Labyrinth
programme.desc: In order to stop Moray's plan of directing a lava flow through Mexico City, the team must navigate through the underground tunnels and find his secret lair. But first they have to get their cars back from the DMV! Once they accomplish that, they learn that tunnels are much more complicated than they appear and Tony makes the ultimate sacrifice in order to help them stop Moray in time.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 1
programme.desc: The Dragon Riders are surprised to discover who is behind recent attacks on nearby ships – and to learn exactly what the ships are.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 2
programme.desc: Heather joins the Dragon Riders, but it's not an easy alliance, especially when Hiccup uncovers a shocking secret about her true identity.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - The Next Big Sting
programme.desc: Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders rescue a wounded Speed Stinger and take it back to Dragon's Edge, unaware of the dangers that follow.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - The Beast of the Wasteland
programme.desc: Po and the Kids are once more waylaid, this time by Mole Rats who have deemed Bao their god. But when Bao isn't able to defeat the mythical creature plaguing the Wasteland, Fan Tong steps up to save the day.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Danger in the Forbidden City
programme.desc: Po and the Kids finally arrive in the Forbidden City. After an assassination scare, Xiao enlists Po and the 4Cs for help protecting her during her father's funeral.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - The Battle(s) of Gongmen Bay
programme.desc: Po and the Kids agree to escort a dirigible shipment of food to a drought-torn region of China. But Nu Hai has some suspicions about Shi Long, which she finds aren't far off when she discovers the dirigible is set to explode...with them on board!
